content.text:
I built the part and exported it to `submission.step`. It's a flat dog bone: a straight bar with a round, slightly wider lobe at each end. It's one valid solid, and reading the STEP file back gave the same volume and size as the part.

- **Size:** 18 × 108 × 7 mm (X × Y × Z). The long side runs along Y and the thickness is along Z.
- **Shape:** a 16 mm wide, 90 mm long bar, with an 18 mm circular lobe centred on each end of the bar. The whole part is 7 mm thick.

I first built it with the long side along X, and the four-view render came out mirrored against `composite.png`. I turned it to run along Y, re-rendered, and the orientation matched in all four views. The shape and proportions also looked close at that point.

Then I made it a little wider and thicker (from 16 × 106 × 6 mm to the size above) to match the picture better, and exported. I didn't re-render after that last change. The sizes are my estimates from the image, so the proportions are approximate.
